title: Best construction site management program.
officialText:
The department shall have the authority to create standards
established by rule for the acceptance of a program that ensures best construction site management practices, and to set
forth the basis and process for removal of such acceptance and for the removal of the program’s name and logo from the
sidewalk shed parapet panel located at a particular site.
